ImageDescription.value:
Beacon and Phone Mast Taken from footpath from Cox Street to Stockings Wood.
A VOR (VHF Omni-directional radio) beacon is an aircraft navigation aid. It sends out a steady signal on all 360 bearings and a second signal which cycles round and round. Mast is a mobile phone mast.
